system:
You are a person scrolling social media. You have never heard of this show.
You just watched a short clip. Below is everything that happens in it - all the
dialogue and action, in order. You have no other information.

Answer strictly from the clip. If the clip does not tell you something, say so
plainly; do not guess from genre convention and do not be generous.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "who_is_the_main_character": "<name them if the clip names them; otherwise describe and say the clip never names them>",
  "what_is_at_stake": "<what the conflict is, or 'unclear from the clip'>",
  "what_question_are_you_left_with": "<the unresolved question, or 'none - it felt finished'>",
  "would_you_keep_watching": "<yes | maybe | no>, then one short reason",
  "passes": {
    "character_identifiable": true/false,
    "stakes_clear": true/false,
    "ends_unresolved": true/false,
    "would_watch": true/false
  }
}

Be strict. "character_identifiable" is false if the clip never says who they are.
"stakes_clear" is false if you had to assume the situation. "ends_unresolved" is
false if the clip resolved its own conflict.
prompt:
THE CLIP:
[sfx] A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.
PRUDENCE: "Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"
[action] Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.
JULIANA: "Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."
PRUDENCE: "My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"
JULIANA: "Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"
[sfx] Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
[action] Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
JULIANA: "His skin is burning hot."
[action] Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
JULIANA: "Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!"
PRUDENCE: "Yes! Right away, I will get it!"
[action] Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
JULIANA: "I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge."
